job.job_description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Engineer with strong expertise in The ideal candidate will have experience building and maintaining high-performance, distributed systems in large-scale e-commerce or high-traffic product environments.

You will design, develop, and scale full-stack solutions, contribute to architectural discussions, and work closely with product and design teams to deliver impactful features with speed and quality.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and scale backend or full-stack systems with high reliability
Drive architectural decisions for scalable, modular, and secure systems
Develop distributed systems, microservices, and APIs (REST / GraphQL)
Contribute to front-end development using modern frameworks when required
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Data teams
Ensure code quality, performance, and efficient CI/CD deployment
Participate in code reviews, mentoring, and continuous improvement initiatives

Required Technical Skills

Backend: Node.js (primary), Python
Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript
APIs: REST, GraphQL
Strong in System Design, Architecture, and Microservices
Experience with CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes
Strong debugging, optimization, and performance-tuning skills
Excellent knowledge of Data Structures, Algorithms, and Distributed Systems

Experience Requirements

10- 15 years of total software engineering experience
4 - 5+ years in high-scale product or e-commerce environments (mandatory)
Proven record in building and scaling production systems
Experience mentoring or leading small pods/teams is a plus

Education

UG: B.Tech / B.E. / B.Sc in Computer Science or related field
PG: M.Tech / M.E. / MCA preferred
